text:
Zoe M: Heads-up from support: a few customers hit OOM failures on big-batch inference jobs. thinking about a failure banner that suggests an actionable retry. sketch: https://redwood.design/oom-retry-banner :paperclip:
Arman V: two short CTA candidates:
  - `Retry with smaller batch`
  - `Retry with conservative batch settings`
Zoe M: i prefer the first — shorter and direct. second feels wordy and vague for non-ML users.
Priya S: agree on brevity. for the banner body we need to be clear about why: e.g. `This request exceeded available memory.` vs `This job ran out of memory.` which tone?
Arman V: lean technical-but-clear: `This request exceeded available GPU memory.` keeps it specific.
Priya S: also include a tiny inline help link for advanced tuning: `(learn more)` linking to docs about batch size, seq length, and quantization. help copy: `Learn how to reduce memory usage`
Zoe M: accessibility & screen-reader text: banner should include an aria-live polite announcement e.g. `Inference failed: exceeded GPU memory. Suggested action: Retry with smaller batch.`
Priya S: tooltip for the CTA (on hover/focus) should explain what the retry will do: `Retries the request with a reduced batch size (automatically chooses a conservative setting).` sentence-case.
Arman V: what about adding a second less-prominent CTA `Adjust settings` that opens the advanced retry modal so power users can tweak batch/seq/quantization? label: `Adjust settings` or `Tweak settings`?
Zoe M: prefer `Adjust settings` — clearer language. ok so banner layout: body text + primary CTA `Retry with smaller batch` + secondary `Adjust settings` + small docs link: `Learn how to reduce memory usage`
Design Bot: accessibility checklist: 1) announce failure via aria-live polite with succinct message and suggested action 2) CTA buttons must have descriptive aria-labels (e.g., `Retry with smaller batch for job 42`) 3) tooltip content must be exposed on focus 4) ensure the banner is keyboard focusable and focus goes to the primary CTA if the banner is actionable 5) color contrast for banner and CTAs meets 4.5:1
Priya S: microcopy polish: body -> `This request exceeded available GPU memory.` helper -> `Try retrying with a smaller batch or adjust advanced settings.` docs link -> `Learn how to reduce memory usage`
Arman V: CTA wording tweak: shorten to `Retry with smaller batch` (no punctuation). aria-label example: `Retry request with a smaller batch to avoid GPU memory errors`
Zoe M: final decision?
Priya S: approved. :white_check_mark:
Arman V: approved. :white_check_mark:
Design Bot: recorded: banner microcopy decided: body = `This request exceeded available GPU memory.` primary CTA = `Retry with smaller batch` (tooltip: `Retries the request with a reduced batch size (automatically chooses a conservative setting).`) secondary CTA = `Adjust settings` (opens advanced modal). docs link = `Learn how to reduce memory usage`. Accessibility: announce via `aria-live="polite"` and use descriptive aria-labels for CTAs. Zoe will add copy and examples to the PR.
